sloka: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम् ।यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम् ।। ७.८८.१० ॥
transliteration: tapantaṁ ca tapastīvramambhomadhye durāsadam ।yaśaskaraṁ kāmakaraṁ kāruṇye paryavasthitam ।। 7.88.10 ॥

translations.english: He was performing intense and formidable penance in the midst of water, established in compassion, bestowing fame and fulfilling desires.
